dissonance: The gear-icon settings panel in the top-left disappears, and any paddle skin / ball speed / difficulty they'd picked stops applying — the game reverts silently to the default classic-white paddle, normal ball speed, and normal AI difficulty on their next visit, with no way to customize it.
